screening_decisions.reason: Randomized controlled trial with 42 patients with frozen shoulder. Patients were randomly allocated to treatment groups including mobilisations (manual therapy) and all patients were taught pendular exercises (exercise). Meets criteria for RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, and includes manual therapy/exercise interventions.

Observational study (not RCT) examining incidence and management of various shoulder disorders in general practice. Not specifically focused on adhesive capsulitis, and does not meet the RCT design requirement.
Educational article describing basic principles of joint mobilization from textbooks. Not a clinical trial, no patients with adhesive capsulitis, no intervention comparison.

Open randomized controlled trial with frozen shoulder patients. Physical therapies provided included therapeutic exercises. Compares physical therapies alone versus physical therapies plus arthrography with steroid. Meets RCT criteria with exercise intervention.
Systematic review examining selective reporting in RCTs. Not a clinical trial on adhesive capsulitis, no intervention study.

Randomized controlled trial on patients with idiopathic adhesive capsulitis. Intervention includes deep transverse friction massage (manual therapy) and capsular stretching (exercise). Meets all selection criteria.

Randomized controlled trial with 29 patients with frozen shoulder comparing two exercise programs (glenohumeral ROM exercises vs glenohumeral ROM + scapulothoracic exercises). Both groups received exercise interventions. Meets RCT criteria with exercise intervention.

Randomized multiple-treatment trial with 28 subjects with frozen shoulder syndrome comparing three mobilization techniques (end-range mobilization, mid-range mobilization, mobilization with movement). All are manual therapy interventions. Meets RCT criteria with manual therapy interventions.

Study comparing PNF movement patterns (exercise) vs conventional free exercises in chronic peri-arthritis (frozen shoulder). While abstract doesn't explicitly state randomization, it describes a comparison of exercise interventions for frozen shoulder. Conservative inclusion due to relevance.

Randomized pilot study with 15 participants with primary adhesive capsulitis comparing antero-posterior vs postero-anterior glide mobilizations (Kaltenborn grade III mobilizations - manual therapy). Meets RCT criteria with manual therapy intervention.
Cross-sectional prevalence study surveying upper limb disorders in general population. Not an RCT, not an intervention study, does not focus specifically on adhesive capsulitis treatment.
Multiple-subject case report, not a randomized controlled trial. While it describes mobilization techniques for adhesive capsulitis, it does not meet the RCT design requirement.

Randomized controlled trial with 93 subjects with adhesive capsulitis comparing corticosteroid injection, supervised physiotherapy, combination, and placebo. Supervised physiotherapy includes exercise components. All subjects taught home exercise program. Meets RCT criteria with exercise intervention.

Randomized, placebo-controlled trial with 156 participants with adhesive capsulitis comparing manual therapy and directed exercise versus placebo after joint distension. Meets RCT criteria with both manual therapy and exercise interventions.
Observational study evaluating responsiveness of a measurement instrument (Shoulder Disability Questionnaire). Not an RCT, not an intervention study on adhesive capsulitis treatment.

Randomized trial with 75 frozen shoulder patients comparing physical therapy, acupuncture, and combination therapy. Physical therapy includes exercise/manual therapy components. Meets RCT criteria with relevant intervention.
Systematic review and cost-effectiveness analysis. Not an RCT, does not present primary trial data on adhesive capsulitis interventions.

Study comparing anterior vs posterior glide mobilization techniques (manual therapy) for adhesive capsulitis. Abstract states purpose but doesn't clearly describe study design. Conservative inclusion due to relevance to manual therapy for adhesive capsulitis.
Methodological study examining outcome reporting bias in Cochrane reviews. Not a clinical trial on adhesive capsulitis treatment.
Despite title mentioning frozen shoulder, the abstract describes a study on multiple sclerosis patients examining social role performance. Wrong population - not adhesive capsulitis patients.

Randomized clinical trial with 87 patients with frozen shoulder comparing corticosteroid injection, physiotherapy, and combination therapy. Physiotherapy includes exercise/manual therapy. Meets RCT criteria with relevant intervention.

Randomized trial with 40 patients with adhesive capsulitis comparing Cyriax approach (deep friction massage and mobilisation exercises) vs conventional physical therapy. Both groups included stretching exercises and home exercise program. Meets RCT criteria with manual therapy and exercise interventions.
Prospective observational study following 49 patients with frozen shoulder over 5-10 years to describe natural history. Not an RCT, no intervention comparison.
Methodological paper developing statistics to quantify heterogeneity in meta-analyses. Not a clinical trial on adhesive capsulitis.
Book chapter about addressing reporting biases in systematic reviews. Not a clinical trial on adhesive capsulitis.
This is a prospective observational study describing the natural history of frozen shoulder, not an RCT or quasi-RCT. No intervention is being tested.

RCT comparing passive mobilization + active exercises vs exercises alone in patients with adhesive capsulitis. Meets all criteria: RCT design, adhesive capsulitis population, manual therapy intervention.
RCT with four groups including physical therapy modalities as one intervention arm for adhesive capsulitis patients. Physical therapy is a relevant comparison intervention.
Not an RCT - this is an EMG study examining muscle activity patterns. Subjects include healthy controls and subjects with shoulder pain (not specifically adhesive capsulitis).
Study focuses on chronic shoulder pain in general, not specifically adhesive capsulitis. Population does not match selection criteria.
RCT comparing steroid injection vs physiotherapy in adhesive capsulitis patients. Physiotherapy is an eligible intervention for this review.
This is a methodology book chapter, not a primary research study.
Retrospective study design, not an RCT or quasi-RCT. Does not meet study design criteria.
RCT comparing two manual therapy mobilization techniques (Mulligan vs Maitland) in adhesive capsulitis patients. Directly relevant to review question.
This is a methodology book chapter, not a primary research study.
Observational epidemiological study examining consultation patterns, not an RCT. Population includes all shoulder pain diagnoses, not specifically adhesive capsulitis.

RCT comparing physiotherapy modalities (iontophoresis, phonophoresis) vs placebo in shoulder periarthritis. While 'periarthritis' is broader than adhesive capsulitis, this may include AC patients and physiotherapy modalities are relevant.
Prospective randomised observer-blind trial comparing local steroids, physiotherapy, or combination for painful stiff shoulder (adhesive capsulitis). Meets all criteria.
Double-blinded RCT comparing electroacupuncture + exercise, interferential + exercise, and no treatment in frozen shoulder patients. Exercise component is relevant to review.
RCT comparing physical therapy + ibuprofen vs ibuprofen alone in adhesive capsulitis patients. Physical therapy is a key intervention of interest.
RCT comparing end range mobilization techniques + exercises/ultrasound vs exercises/ultrasound alone in adhesive capsulitis. Manual therapy intervention present.
RCT comparing anterior vs posterior glide joint mobilization techniques in adhesive capsulitis patients. Directly addresses manual therapy question.
RCT with four groups including physiotherapy alone and combined with injection in adhesive capsulitis patients. Physiotherapy is a relevant intervention.
Prospective randomised trial comparing manipulation under anaesthesia, peri-articular injection, and physiotherapy for adhesive capsulitis. Includes manual therapy and physiotherapy arms.
This is a systematic review, not a primary RCT. Review articles are excluded by study design criteria.
This is a methodology book chapter, not a primary research study.
RCT comparing joint mobilization vs self-exercises in adhesive capsulitis patients. Both interventions are relevant to the review (manual therapy and exercise).
Prospective systematically allocated clinical trial (quasi-RCT) comparing manipulation + exercise vs mobilization + exercise in adhesive capsulitis. Both manual therapy and exercise interventions.
RCT comparing high-grade vs low-grade mobilization techniques in adhesive capsulitis patients. Manual therapy intervention directly relevant to review.
Single-blinded randomised pilot study comparing home-care vs home-care + passive mobilisation in adhesive capsulitis patients. Manual therapy intervention present.
